credits.title: Miraculous World: Shanghai - The Legend of Ladydragon
credits.overview: On school break, Marinette heads to Shanghai to meet Adrien. But after arriving, Marinette loses all her stuff, including the Miraculous that allows her to turn into Ladybug!

credits.title: Mama Weed
credits.overview: A translator working for the police gets involved in the other side of drug dealing.

credits.title: Little Tickles
credits.overview: Odette is a 8-yr-old girl who loves to dance and draw. Once she has become an adult, Odette realizes she was abused, and immerses herself body and soul in her career as a dancer while trying to deal with her past.

credits.title: Je suis une page blanche
credits.overview: A woman arrives in Paris, with the hope in her heart of resuming writing a book she closed too soon.
